messages:
Maya (Support): customer: per-model throughput graphs for gpt-redwood-7b and gpt-redwood-13b show a flatline starting ~2026-06-01 06:10 UTC. API requests are succeeding, just the per-model panels are zeroed out. link to dashboard: https://grafana.internal/r/d/abcd1234
Sam (Eng-Platform): can you drop the dashboard panel link + an example timeseries query?
Maya (Support): panel link above. panel query is something like: sum(rate(redwood_inference_requests_total{env=\"prod\"}[5m])) by (model_name)
Priya (DataEng): pulling metrics from ingestion. We deployed a relabeling change yesterday that normalized labels. We renamed model_name -> model_id and dropped model_name in the pipeline to avoid duplication. This was in the prom-relabel PR: relabel: - source_labels: [model_name] target_label: model_id action: replace - action: labeldrop regex: model_name
Arjun (Eng-ML): dashboards were built with sum by(model_name) historically. If model_name disappeared, panels will return no series (effectively flat/zero).
Leo (Eng-Runtime): confirmed on our end: exporter now emits model_id=\"gpt-redwood-7b:v2\" and no model_name label. Example raw metric: redwood_inference_requests_total{model_id=\"gpt-redwood-7b:v2\",route=\"/v1/generate\"} 42
Sam (Eng-Platform): ok. two mitigation options: 1) restore a compatibility label copy (model_id -> model_name) in ingestion, or 2) update all dashboards and alerts to the new label. Which is faster for prod recovery?
Priya (DataEng): copying label is fastest. I can add a relabel rule to set model_name = model_id (or strip version suffix if desired) and roll it. Doing that will keep both labels for a short migration window.
Maya (Support): told customer: "we see the issue, investigating; dashboards affected by a recent label rename, working on hotfix; will update in 30m" :thumbsup:
Priya (DataEng): preparing change. Planned relabel snippet: - source_labels: [model_id] target_label: model_name action: replace # backfill compatibility
deploy-bot: deploy started: prom-relabeler v2026.06.01-compat.
Priya (DataEng): rolled to 2/4 ingestion nodes — seeing model_name reappear in metrics stream for new samples. Grafana should pick up soon (refresh interval 15s).
Arjun (Eng-ML): reminder: some dashboards use model (short name) vs model_name vs model_id inconsistently. We'll want a mapping doc: model_id -> model_name (strip :vN) -> model.
Maya (Support): customer just confirmed panels are returning values and throughput lines recovered.
Sam (Eng-Platform): leaving this open until full rollout. Priya, follow up with a short postmortem: what changed, why labeldrop was added, and migration plan so we don't break dashboards.
Priya (DataEng): will write a short postmortem + add a 48h compatibility window to label renames. Also will add a Prometheus relabel test to our CI to detect dashboard-query regressions.
Leo (Eng-Runtime): also adding an alert to catch sudden drop-to-zero for per-model series (sum by(model_name)) so we detect this class of break earlier.
Maya (Support): passing resolution to customer, closing the escalation. Thanks everyone. :rocket:
